info.title: Microsoft SARIF Multitool (includes SARIF SDK
info.description: Multi-purpose command line tool for analyzing and manipulating SARIF files

commands.name: absoluteuri
commands.description: Turn all relative Uris into absolute URIs (to be used after rebaseUri is run)

options.name: --log
options.description: Optionally present data, expressed as a semicolon-delimited list enclosed in double quotes, for governing output files. Valid values include ForceOverwrite, Inline, PrettyPrint, Minify or Optimize.

options.name: --insert
options.description: Optionally present data, expressed as a semicolon-delimited list enclosed in double quotes, that should be inserted into the log file. Valid values include Hashes, TextFiles, BinaryFiles, EnvironmentVariables, RegionSnippets, ContextRegionSnippets, ContextRegionSnippetPartialFingerprints, RollingHashPartialFingerprints, Guids, VersionControlDetails, and NondeterministicProperties.

options.name: --remove
options.description: Optionally present data, expressed as a semicolon-delimited list enclosed in double quotes, that should be not be persisted to or which should be removed from the log file. Valid values include Hashes, TextFiles, BinaryFiles, EnvironmentVariables, RegionSnippets, ContextRegionSnippets, Guids, VersionControlDetails, and NondeterministicProperties.

options.name: --uriBaseIds
options.description: Key + value pairs, expressed as a semicolon-delimited list enclosed in double quotes, that defines a uriBaseId and its corresponding local file path. E.g., SRC=c:\src;TEST=c:\test

options.name: --sarif-output-version
options.description: The SARIF version of the output log file. Valid values are OneZeroZero and Current [default: 2]

options.name: --threads
options.description: A count of threads that should be used for multithreaded operations.

options.name: --insert-property
options.description: JSON path + property values, expressed as a semicolon-delimited list enclosed in double quotes, that should be inserted into the output log. Currently, only paths that point to a version control provenance property bag is supported, e.g., 'runs[0].invocations[1].versionControlProvenance.properties.myProperty=myValue'.

options.name: --automation-id
options.description: An id that will be persisted to the 'Run.AutomationDetails.Id' property. See section '3.17.3' of the SARIF specification for more information.

options.name: --automation-guid
options.description: A guid that will be persisted to the 'Run.AutomationDetails.Guid' property. See section '3.17.4' of the SARIF specification for more information.

options.name: --recurse
options.description: Recursively select subdirectories in paths. [default: False]

options.name: --output-directory
options.description: A directory to output the transformed files to. If absent, each transformed file is written to the same directory as the corresponding input file.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: emit-finalize
commands.description: Replay a staged SARIF event log into a final SARIF file.

options.name: --no-cwe-enrichment
options.description: Skip enrichment of CWE-as-rule-id descriptors from the embedded MITRE CWE taxonomy. [default: False]

options.name: --keep-wip
options.description: Retain the '<output>.wip.jsonl' event log after successful finalize. Useful for forensics and reruns. [default: False]

options.name: --minify
options.description: Produce compact (single-line) JSON rather than indented output. [default: False]

options.name: --embed-text-files
options.description: Embed the textual content of every text-file artifact referenced by the run (run.artifacts[].contents.text). Use for self-contained AI fixtures and to clear SARIF2013. [default: False]

options.name: --validate
options.description: After writing the SARIF, run the multitool validator (--rule-kind Sarif;AI) against the output. Fails with non-zero exit and prints a summary if any Error-level findings are reported. Warnings/Notes are summarized but do not fail. [default: False]

options.name: --no-repo
options.description: Finalize a scan that has no version control (a local working copy, an unpacked container image, or a downloaded package). Tolerates absent run.versionControlProvenance, elides any transient local file:// source-root base from the output, and marks each run unpublishable. An unpublishable run cannot be uploaded to a code-scanning alert store, which anchors every alert to a repository and commit. [default: False]

commands.name: get-cwe
commands.description: Emit canonical MITRE CWE data (id, name, slug, ruleId fallback, status, help). Pass CWE ids or --all.

options.name: --all
options.description: Emit every entry in the embedded catalog, including deprecated and obsolete CWEs. Mutually exclusive with <ids>. [default: False]

options.name: --concise
options.description: Omit the full MITRE help markdown from each record, emitting only the high-level fields. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: 'json' (default) or 'markdown'. [default: 0]

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to write the output to. If omitted, the output is written to stdout.

options.name: --force-overwrite
options.description: Overwrite the --output file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

arguments.name: VALUE
arguments.description: Comma-separated CWE ids to emit (e.g., '89', 'CWE-89', '79,89'). Mutually exclusive with --all.

options.name: --strategy
options.description: Splitting strategy. Supported values: PerRule, PerRunPerRule, PerRunPerTarget, PerRunPerTargetPerRule, PerRun, PerResult, PerIndexList. PerIndexList requires --indices. [default: 3]

options.name: --indices
options.description: Required when --strategy=PerIndexList. A spec in the compact mini-language: '<runId>:<r1>,<r2>,...;<runId>:...|<bucket>|...'. The '<runId>:' prefix is optional and defaults to 0. SARIF URLs ('sarif:/runs/X/results/Y') are also accepted as segments. Buckets are separated by '|', segments within a bucket by ';', and indices within a segment by ','. Buckets are auto-named 'bucket0', 'bucket1', etc. Duplicate or out-of-range addresses cause an error.

options.name: --spillover-bucket
options.description: Optional bucket name (only meaningful with --strategy=PerIndexList). When set, any result not addressed by --indices is written to this bucket instead of being discarded.

options.name: --strict-coverage
options.description: Only meaningful with --strategy=PerIndexList. When set, every result in the input log must be addressed by --indices (or covered by --spillover-bucket); otherwise the command fails.
